title: Count how many siblings
description:
How many siblings do you have?

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as count_siblings(siblings), where siblings is a tuple of names, returning the number of siblings as an integer.
hints: The number of siblings is just how many items are in the siblings tuple.
Python has a single built-in function that reports how many items any sequence, including a tuple, contains.
Return len(siblings) - the length of the tuple is exactly the count you need.
expected_behavior: Returns the number of items in the siblings tuple.
explanation: len() works on any sequence type, including tuples, and returns the number of elements it holds - here that number is the sibling count.
